1. Summary of the primary business
Business overview – products and services
We are an Indian manufacturer and supplier of fire protection equipment and systems, offering a comprehensive portfolio 
spanning water, foam and gas-based fire suppression systems, also generally known as fire fighting products. We develop 
the majority of our products in-house with proprietary designs to meet national and international standards, serving high￾hazard industrial applications as well as residential and commercial sectors. 
Industries served and typical customers
Our products cater to (a) industrial end-use sectors such as industrials, heavy engineering, aerospace, oil & gas, refining 
and petrochemicals, power & energy, pharmaceuticals, data centres and warehousing, among others; and (b) residential 
and commercial end-use sectors such as hospitality, healthcare, retail, education and banking. We supplied our fire 
protection equipment and systems to 2,066 customers in Fiscal 2026, across more than 90 countries between inception and 
March 31, 2026, and across 49 countries in the three-month period ended June 30, 2026.

2. Summary of the Industry (Source: CRISIL Report)
The Indian fire protection equipment market expanded at a CAGR of 12% between Fiscals 2020 and 2026 to ₹109 billion, 
outperforming the global fire protection equipment market in terms of growth rate (7% CAGR between 2020-2025), and 
is expected to grow at a CAGR of 10-12% between Fiscals 2026 and 2031 to reach ₹175-195 billion. In Fiscal 2026, the 
fire suppression system segment (fire sprinklers, hydrants, deluge valves, gas-based systems, foam equipment & 
suppression systems, etc.) accounted for 75% of the total market and was valued at ₹82 billion, and is expected to grow at 
a CAGR of 11.0-13.0% between Fiscals 2026 and 2031 to reach ₹135-155 billion, retaining a 75-80% share of the overall 
market.
India lags key developed markets in terms of per capita fire protection equipment consumption — India stood at just US$1 
(Fiscal 2026), as compared to US$57 in North America and US$52 in Europe (CY2025), presenting an opportunity for 
growth. Our Company was the second-largest manufacturer of fire protection equipment and systems in India in terms of 
operating income (revenue from operations) in Fiscal 2025 and the largest exporter by value (equipment) in Fiscal 2025.
For further information, see “Industry Overview” beginning on page 144 of the Red Herring Prospectus.

The Indian fire protection equipment market expanded at a CAGR of 12% between Fiscals 2020 and 2026 to ₹109 billion, 
outperforming the global fire protection equipment market in terms of growth rate (7% CAGR between 2020-2025), and 
is expected to grow at a CAGR of 10-12% between Fiscals 2026 and 2031 to reach ₹175-195 billion. In Fiscal 2026, the 
fire suppression system segment (fire sprinklers, hydrants, deluge valves, gas-based systems, foam equipment & 
suppression systems, etc.) accounted for 75% of the total market and was valued at ₹82 billion, and is expected to grow at 
a CAGR of 11.0-13.0% between Fiscals 2026 and 2031 to reach ₹135-155 billion, retaining a 75-80% share of the overall 
market.
India lags key developed markets in terms of per capita fire protection equipment consumption — India stood at just US$1 
(Fiscal 2026), as compared to US$57 in North America and US$52 in Europe (CY2025), presenting an opportunity for 
growth. Our Company was the second-largest manufacturer of fire protection equipment and systems in India in terms of 
operating income (revenue from operations) in Fiscal 2025 and the largest exporter by value (equipment) in Fiscal 2025.
